driverDetectorReproduction.method: Executes the exact unchanged production detector accumulation block with constant target HP. Target is outside fire-axe range for 8.5 seconds, then approaches to 1.1m. No attack or damage events are supplied because this block reads neither.
driverDetectorReproduction.block:
if (threat.hp !== seen.hp) { seen.hp = threat.hp; seen.ms = 0; } else seen.ms += Math.min(500, now - seen.last);
    seen.last = now; shotAt.set(threat.id, seen);

nativeCampaignScan.method: Ordinary native campaign policy; living targets within 1.5m accepted by melee query during running melee action. Continuity resets on gap or HP change. Bounded windows, not full routes.
